Southeast Fencing & Gates — pricing, updated August 2026

All prices below INCLUDE GST. We're based in Berwick and we travel up to 30km from there, which
covers Beaconsfield, Officer, Pakenham, Narre Warren, Clyde, Cranbourne, Hampton Park, Hallam,
Endeavour Hills and Doveton. There is no travel charge anywhere inside that 30km. We don't go into
the CBD or down the peninsula.

Minimum charge is $850 for any job.

This is charged SEPARATELY and on top of the supply-and-install rate above.

GATES (priced per gate, not per metre)
Single pedestrian gate, timber, up to 1.2m wide — $480
Single pedestrian gate, Colorbond — $520
Double / driveway gate, timber, up to 3.6m — $1,340
Double / driveway gate, Colorbond, up to 3.6m — $1,480
Sliding driveway gate, aluminium — $2,650
Gate motor supply and install — $1,450 per motor.

SITE CONDITIONS THAT CHANGE THE PRICE
Sloped or stepped blocks — add $14 per metre.
Rock or hand-dig only where the machine can't get in — add $22 per metre.
Restricted access, e.g. no side gate and everything carried through the house — add $9 per metre.
Travel — no charge within our 30km area.

HOW WE BUILD
Posts are 100x100mm H4 treated pine, set at 2.4m centres, 700mm deep, in concrete footings, with a
hole diameter of 300mm. Three rails of 75x50mm per bay. Palings are 150x12mm. Capping is available
at 150x25mm for an extra $5 per metre. Colorbond, aluminium, pool fencing and chainmesh all use the manufacturer's own system posts,
rails and panels, set to the same 2.4m spacing and 700mm depth in concrete. Rural post and wire
uses 125mm round treated posts at 4m spacing, 900mm deep, no rails or capping.

PERMITS
Council permits and inspection fees are the customer's responsibility. We'll tell you at the
measure-up if we think you need one.

WARRANTY
All our workmanship is warranted for 7 years. Materials carry their manufacturer's warranty.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
Site inspection and measure-up, all standard materials and fixings, concrete footings, standard
excavation, installation, clean-up and removal of our own rubbish.

WHAT'S NOT INCLUDED
Engineering drawings, asbestos handling, relocating services, tree or stump removal, landscaping,
painting or staining.

We do custom gates and we're happy to work on steep blocks. 20 years in the south-east, fully
insured, and we do our own installs rather than subbing out.
